title: File:Ruins of the evacuated Israeli settlement of Yamit, Northern Sinai, 1983.jpg
author: Evdpnl
description: View of the total destruction of the former Israeli settlement of Yamit, located in Northern Sinai, Egypt. The photograph was taken in 1983 during an MFO Military Police patrol, one year after the final withdrawal.
